verification.source: Full release gate split by platform; no GitHub Actions or NAS
steps: Root, executor and conformance Go modules: gofmt, go mod tidy -diff, vet and go test -race passed on Linux (gate-cli image, uid 1000)
Root module three-architecture Linux vet/build passed
Rust fmt/clippy/tests and three DSM targets passed in the Docker gate image
Python tests, mypy and Python 3.8; Node App tests, pack contents and Node 18 passed
508 TypeScript tests against UI 0.13.0, typecheck/build/pack and packed consumer import passed
Executor three-architecture Linux vet/build and cold-cache executor/lifecycle reproducibility passed
A contract test drives the production executor through delegate.Client under a deadline: webapi.call fails with INVALID_REQUEST before the fix and passes after
verification.comparisonWith0.19.0: All three executor digests changed; all three lifecycle digests are unchanged (go1.26.9).
verification.approvalImpact: Rebuild executor Apps to ship the fix; each requires one administrator reapproval after upgrade. No NAS upgrade certification was performed.
